findings.description: Each place where the draft is wrong against the decisions or the pins. Empty when there is none

kind.description: contradicts a decision: the draft says other than the log. contradicts a pin: the draft changes behavior a pin records and no decision changes that pin. decision not shown: a decision's concrete case has no scenario. beyond the decisions: the draft specifies behavior no decision asked for. cannot be checked: a scenario is too vague to pass or fail

against.description: The decision (D3) or the pin (TestClass#method) the finding rests on

claim.description: What is wrong, in one or two sentences

where.description: The place in the draft: path:line or path:line-line, relative to the repository's root

quote.description: Eight to 150 characters copied exactly from the cited lines of the draft

needs_decision.description: True when only the owner can settle it, false when the decisions already say what is right
